integrity: Integral homotopy established by face classification and simply connected two-dimensional core; independent finite mod-two computation corroborates four cases. No outside mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Distinct primes only; no equivariant classification. Pinckney (2021, Chapter 8) reports unpublished preliminary structure for odd-prime dihedral groups, so unverified overlap with that unpublished work remains possible.
title: Two-dimensional homotopy of irredundant generating-subset complexes of dihedral groups of squarefree rotational order
